# SOPHIA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 16
**Agent:** SOPHIA (Consensus)
**Source:** P.Ryl. 463 + P.Oxy 3525 (Greek fragments) | Coptic/Greek
**Chapter:** 16

---

*[Chapter 16 is drawn from the Greek papyrus fragments. The text is highly fragmentary and no running translation is possible.]*

**16:1** [P.Ryl. 463:] [...] "...the Good, and the [fullness] of the [All] will be [restored] [...]"

**16:2** [...] And he said to them, "[...] beware that no one [leads you] astray [...]"

**16:3** [...] the Son of Man [...] within you [...] follow [...]

---

*Council Note (SOPHIA):* The Greek fragments yield only these partial lines. "Fullness" (*plērōma*) is adopted over PNEUMA's "wholeness" — *plērōma* is the standard transliteration in Valentinian studies and its capitalized form signals the technical meaning.
